name: Leap of Faith
source:
Toby and Alice have been friends online for a year and he's finally going to meet up her in real life. Should he tell her that he likes her romantically too?

[From [url=https://unicorncreates.itch.io/leap-of-faith]itch.io[/url]]

托比和爱丽丝在网上成为朋友一年了，他终于要在现实生活中见到她了。他应该告诉她他也喜欢她吗？

[来自[url=https://unicorncreates.itch.io/leap-of-faith]itch.io[/url]]
